description: Maantieteellisten nimien NLS-FI INSPIRE-katselupalvelu is a dataset listed in Paikkatietohakemisto, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by inspire-wms.maanmittauslaitos.fi. NLS-FI INSPIRE View Service for Geographical Names Theme is an INSPIRE compliant Web Map Service. It contains the following harmonized INSPIRE map layers: NamedPlace. The service is based on the Geographic Names Register of the National Land Survey of Finland. The dataset is administrated by the National Land Survey of Finland. Coverage: FI. The portal shows the English title as "NLS-FI INSPIRE View Service for Geographical Names" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-paikkatietohakemisto.
